record.paper_title: Traces on Operator Ideals Defined over the Class of all Banach Spaces and Related Open Problems
record.context_brief: Restriction of the strange trace to \ell_2.
record.original_question: Let X_K be the Argyros-Haydon C_0-trivial Banach space used in the paper's construction of the singular trace τ_Z on the quasi-Banach operator ideal N(2/3,Z). Describe the restriction of τ_Z to the component N(2/3,X_K)(\ell_2), and determine in particular whether this restriction might vanish identically on all of N(2/3,X_K)(\ell_2).

evidence.quote:
Problem 23. Describe the restriction of τZ to N(2/3,XK)(ℓ2).
It may even happen that τZ = o on all of N(2/3,XK)(ℓ2).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Let $X_K$ denote an Argyros–Haydon Banach space: an infinite-dimensional separable Banach space with a Schauder basis on which every bounded linear operator has the form $\lambda I + S$ with $\lambda$ a scalar and $S$ a compact operator (a $\mathcal{C}_0$-trivial Banach space).

For $0<r<\infty$ and a Banach space $Y$, recall the quasi-Banach ideal $\mathfrak{N}^{(r)}$ of $r$-nuclear operators: an operator $T:Y\to Z$ between Banach spaces belongs to $\mathfrak{N}^{(r)}(Y,Z)$ iff it admits a representation
$$T=\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} y_n^*\otimes z_n,\quad y_n^*\in Y^*,\ z_n\in Z,\quad \sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\|y_n^*\|^r\|z_n\|^r<\infty,$$
with the natural quasi-norm. Fix $r=2/3$.

Let $\mathfrak{Z}$ be the operator ideal whose components $\mathfrak{Z}(Y,Z)$ are characterized as follows: $T\in\mathfrak{Z}(Y,Z)$ iff $T$ factors through some $\mathcal{C}_0$-trivial Banach space (e.g. through an Argyros–Haydon space). Define the quasi-Banach operator ideal $\mathfrak{N}^{(2/3)}_{\mathfrak{Z}}$ by intersecting $\mathfrak{N}^{(2/3)}$ with $\mathfrak{Z}$ component-wise.

Assume the existence of a non-zero singular trace $\tau_{\mathfrak{Z}}$ on $\mathfrak{N}^{(2/3)}_{\mathfrak{Z}}$, that is, a linear functional defined on every component $\mathfrak{N}^{(2/3)}_{\mathfrak{Z}}(Y,Y)$ which is invariant under cyclic commutation: $\tau_{\mathfrak{Z}}(AB)=\tau_{\mathfrak{Z}}(BA)$ for compatible operators.

Restriction to $\ell_2$. Consider the component
$$\mathfrak{N}^{(2/3)}_{X_K}(\ell_2):=\{\,T\in\mathfrak{N}^{(2/3)}(\ell_2,\ell_2)\ :\ T\text{ factors through }X_K\,\}.$$

Problem.
(a) Describe explicitly the restriction of $\tau_{\mathfrak{Z}}$ to $\mathfrak{N}^{(2/3)}_{X_K}(\ell_2)$.

(b) In particular, determine whether $\tau_{\mathfrak{Z}}\equiv 0$ on the whole of $\mathfrak{N}^{(2/3)}_{X_K}(\ell_2)$.
artifact.category_tag: Traces on operator ideals on Banach spaces
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an explicit open problem in the literature on traces on operator ideals over the class of all Banach spaces, where it is left as a question whose answer is unknown — including whether the restricted trace might be identically zero. No subsequent solution was located.
